title: ReNova
description: Optimization algorithm that crosses seven different sources of information and ranks the buildings by refurbishment priority based on a budget and a specific target metric, for example thermal efficiency, energy consumption or CO2 emissions.

title: Enercast
description: Energy consumption prediction tool based on a recurrent neural network model that infers the energy consumption of a given city within Europe for a selected span of days.

title: Vulens
description: Vulnerability assessment tool based on the ISV developed by the city of Zaragoza. As a result, the model creates groups of neighbourhoods sharing the same vulnerabilities or resiliences, allowing stakeholders to properly address social problems in the cities.

title: SPADE-NORMS
description: Plugin for the well-known and widely used MAS platform SPADE. This plugin brings the possibility of adding normative and value-aware reasoning to the developed MAS. The system has also proved to work with Reinforcement Learning agents.
